Class ScopedValueSupport

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.linker.ScopedValueSupport
public final class ScopedValueSupport extends Object
Closed-world plumbing for the java.lang.ScopedValue subset (JDK 25, final API). A ScopedValue is a small key id and a Carrier is a chain of arena-allocated bindings; run/call enter the carrier in the runtime shim and invoke the program's Runnable/CallableOp through the generated entry functions, which this class registers as synthetic interface-call sites.
